remarks: This Cabrillo Walk townhome in the heart of Torrance checks all the right boxes! Built in 2006, this well-maintained gem offers 3 bedrooms, 3 bathrooms, and 1,690 sq ft of comfortable, well-designed living space. A charming garden walkway leads to a gated front patio ready for weekend BBQs and al fresco dining. Inside, the main level keeps things flowing with an inviting living area, dining space, and kitchen featuring granite countertops, a center island, and stainless steel appliances. A convenient powder room rounds out the floor. Upstairs, three bedrooms offer a little separation from the hustle and bustle.
